description: Power Distribution Substation Dataset for Cybersecurity IoE is a data set deposited in Zenodo by its authors Mariana Luiza Flavio, Charles Prado (Instituto Nacional de Metrologia, Qualidade e Tecnologia). Dataset for the paper 'Stealth AI-Enabled MitM Attacks in Power Distribution SCADA Systems' (2025). Data from the behavior of the monitored variables of a Voltage Transformer in a power substation. Voltage step-down unit. Coverage: a single site or case study; the metadata date the deposit to 2025. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-zenodo-repository.
